notes: Written by g-ea (gap batch) on 2026-11-01 from four pages. The Union is a British colony set up by agreements with the Malay rulers (MacMichael, 1945: the page gives no day), so the nine Malay states are drawn as part of it for its 22 months. Two predecessors and one successor have no usable dossier: unfederated-malay-states (Johor, Kedah, Kelantan, Perlis, Terengganu as British protected states 1909/1914-1946, no Cliopatria row) and british-military-administration-malaya (1945-1946) need dossiers; federation-of-malaya.json starts only in 1957, so the Federation of Malaya of 1 February 1948 to 1957 (a protected state of the United Kingdom) has no dossier of its own and the Union's successor link points at a state not yet alive. The straits-settlements and federated-malay-states dossiers cite this slug exactly as written. Singapore went to a separate Crown colony on 1 April 1946 (colony-of-singapore has no dossier either); Labuan joined North Borneo on 15 July 1946 (straits-settlements' ledger) and is not part of the Union. The two end dates (31 January infobox, 1 February body) disagree; the infobox date is used, the same year either way. No ruler strip: the page names only Sir Edward Gent as governor at the start. The Malayan Emergency began after the Union's end and is not listed. Wikidata id left null (not given by any page opened).
